note: Banco Ficohsa's card rates for November 2025: its international Classic card bears 30.00% to 46.00% a year on dollar balances (and up to 51.26% on lempira ones), written at the top; its membership, priced at 5 dollars a month for a Classic card, is billed monthly in lempiras from the next renewal. The card is kept in dollars, the currency its membership is priced in.
